$comment: 3M (Safety-Walk and tape products) is behind Akamai, which denies every page fetch from this network (HTTP, headless Chrome, and AvalAI's browser fetch). AvalAI's own HTTP fetch did return the page (10 features, an image), but that fetch is not reproducible from our side, so this site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search. The shop is never contacted; values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED). Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http and browser: ACCESS_DENIED; ai_fetch http: success (2,391+582 tokens, not used: no saved page); ai_fetch browser: ACCESS_DENIED; web_search: success (10 features, 564+313 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
